digest.component_or_area: overlap judge — prompt caching and token optimization
propositions: The query ticket digest is resent verbatim in the user message of every overlap judge call within a batch, occupying token space paid at full price each time instead of being cached
Moving the invariant query digest into the cacheable system prompt block can reduce per-call token cost only if the resulting prefix reaches the model's minimum cacheable prefix threshold

Real API measurements show the applicable cache floor for anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6 is 1024 tokens, not the 4096 documented for Opus models, but the hoisted prefix at 846 tokens still falls short and produces a +5.8% token regression
Precision of overlap verdicts (relation, shared_artifact, confidence) must be verified to remain identical when the query digest is relocated from inline user message to system prompt reference

The sequential judge loop does not require warm-up before parallelization today, but any future parallelization must complete one call to warm the cache before fanning out remaining calls to avoid N expensive writes instead of 1 write plus N-1 cheap reads
